title: Follow-up Support
meta: Questions answered and progress checked after training, so new habits stick. From $50, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: Training works best when someone checks in afterwards. For a set period after your workshops or setup, your team sends us questions by email and we reply with clear answers and examples. We also review how people are using the tools, point out what is working, fix common slips and suggest the next small step. It is a fixed starter sprint, and ongoing support is quoted separately.

faq: Do I need to have bought training from you?
No, but it helps us if we know what your team learned. If you trained elsewhere, tell us which tools and methods they use and we adapt.
How do my team send questions?
By email to a dedicated address, or in a shared channel if you prefer. We also accept screenshots, with private details covered, so we can see what happened.
Can you fix a tool that is not working?
We can find why it is behaving badly and suggest changes to the instructions. Building or repairing larger systems is a separate job that we can quote.
This is a fixed starter sprint. If you want regular monthly support after it, we quote that separately based on your team size and how many questions you expect.
